description: List a board's cards, in board order by default (column then position). `archived` narrows to false|true|all (default false); `updatedSince` (ISO 8601) narrows to cards changed after it, for incremental sync.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous page of this same list.

limit.description: Page size (max 200). Omitted: the whole collection, one response.
